question.problem:
$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=-{x}_{1}(t)+4{x}_{2}(t) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=-2{x}_{2}(t)+1,\end{aligned}\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 3\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the initial value problem above. By applying the Laplace transform $L$ to both sides of each equation in our system, we get a system with variables ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}.$ In terms of the parameter $s,$ the solution of the new system is

${X}_{1}(s)=$ {{field-1}} $,\,$
${X}_{2}(s)=\frac{3s+1}{s(s+2)}$ .
question.worked_solution:
First, we compute the Laplace transforms of both sides of each equation in our system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}L\{{x}_{1}^{′}(t)\}=L\{-{x}_{1}(t)+4{x}_{2}(t)\} \\ L\{{x}_{2}^{′}(t)\}=L\{-2{x}_{2}(t)+1\}\end{aligned}\,\,
$$

Using the derivative property of the Laplace transform, we obtain the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}sL\{{x}_{1}(t)\}-{x}_{1}(0)=-L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}+4L\{{x}_{2}(t)\} \\ sL\{{x}_{2}(t)\}-{x}_{2}(0)=-2L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}+L\{1\}\end{aligned}
$$

which can be simplified to the following:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s)+1=-{X}_{1}(s)+4{X}_{2}(s) \\ s{X}_{2}(s)-3=-2{X}_{2}(s)+\frac{1}{s}\end{aligned}
$$

where ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\},$ and we have used the fact that $L\{1\}=\frac{1}{s}.$

Now, solving the second equation for ${X}_{2}(s),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}s{X}_{2}(s)-3 & =-2{X}_{2}(s)+\frac{1}{s} \\ (s+2){X}_{2}(s) & =3+\frac{1}{s} \\ (s+2){X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{3s+1}{s} \\ {X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{3s+1}{s(s+2)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting this in the first equation and solving for ${X}_{1}(s)$, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s)+1 & =-{X}_{1}(s)+4{X}_{2}(s) \\ (s+1){X}_{1}(s) & =4{X}_{2}(s)-1 \\ (s+1){X}_{1}(s) & =4(\frac{3s+1}{s(s+2)})-1 \\ (s+1){X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{4(3s+1)-s(s+2)}{s(s+2)} \\ (s+1){X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{12s+4-({s}^{2}+2s)}{s(s+2)} \\ (s+1){X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{-{s}^{2}+10s+4}{s(s+2)} \\ {X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{-{s}^{2}+10s+4}{s(s+2)(s+1)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution of the new system in terms of parameter $s$ is 

$$
{X}_{1}(s)=\frac{-{s}^{2}+10s+4}{s(s+1)(s+2)},\,{X}_{2}(s)=\frac{3s+1}{s(s+2)}.
$$
